values.note: 2026 and 2027: $25 a night. One vehicle included; each extra vehicle $8 a night.

values.note: 15 sites for RVs and tents (recreation.gov catalogues 14: 12 for RVs, 2 tent-only), all back-in. Parking spurs 30-45 ft per the FS page; the forest's status table gives max spur 30 ft; catalogued at 30-40 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/west-chicago-creek-campground ('There are 15 sites available for RV and tent camping'; 'The parking length ranges from 30 to 45 feet') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Clear Creek RD Campground Status: West Chicago Creek, Sites '15', Max Spur '30''') + RIDB catalog for 231859 (Max Vehicle Length 32 ft x8, 40 ft x2, 30 ft x1; Driveway Entry Back-In x11), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water: the well is out of service, so bring all the water you need.

values.note: Reservations close 4 days before arrival; a site not occupied within 26 hours of the start goes to walk-ups. A few sites are first-come. No site swapping.
